blocks.text: Rectification is the process of converting alternating current into direct current.
bold: Rectification is the process of converting alternating current into direct current.

blocks.text: Diodes allow current to flow in one direction (forward bias) but block it in the opposite direction (reverse bias). Rectification is of two types, half wave rectification and full wave rectification. Rectification is commonly used in electronic devices that require a stable DC power source, such as computers and smartphones, as most household and commercial power is AC.
